title: Qwen3.6-27B Q4_K_M sole-T16 first XTX fit and dense-prefill owner

dense_prefill.q4_tile: 48 columns x 64 rows per wave; four-wave shared decoded K256 B slab
dense_prefill.association: same FP16 operands, ordered K16 WMMA sequence, FP32 accumulators, and BF16 stores as the pre-existing T16 producer

implementation.decode: existing exact T16 c1 and rows-2-4 owners consume the same sole tiles allocation
implementation.fallback: same-layout unfused linear chains remain registered; no pack8 shadow is allocated

first_fit_progression.candidate: shape-screened Q4 3x4, Q5 2x4, Q6 3x4 wave tiles

decision: Keep sole T16 and the exact shared-B/wide dense producers as the first operation-complete XTX fit. This is not campaign closure: it misses the frozen llama.cpp HIP prefill speed gate and Vulkan VRAM gate, so optimization continues with device-visible host ownership and/or a sole raw-GGUF rung.
